title: Biomes SMP
description: This plugin makes the server a lot more interesting with biomes, including teams of the biomes and a huge battle!
body:
This plugin is for paper 1.21.11.

What happens when you join the server for the first time, you get shown a wheel with four biomes, forest (oak), taiga (spruce), dark oak, and jungle.

If you roll one of them, you get teleported to that biome and you have to build a base there and gather loot there.

The plains biome is free roam, you can loot anything in this biome and build a base there too.
However, some biomes are completely locked off, like birch, ice biomes, and cherry blossoms, and you can't do anything in them.

After two weeks of the server being up and on also, the battle begins, and everyone gets teleported to 0, 0.

If one biome wins, they get bragging rights.

There are also team leaders, being rolled one hour after the server starts.

However, you can still raid people and break and loot player-made builds and chests and anything!

This plugin is being used in a private SMP called The Biomes SMP. And you can use it too.
(i also tried a new description style, i hope you like it!)

https://discord.com/invite/jtQAdXKnu6 for mod support and talking!

**Made By MaceMeta**
